name: zclass_gwnode_find_next_by_name
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeFindNextByName delegates exact-name filtered bucket iteration to zClass_List::IterateBucketFiltered.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this wrapper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass list/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44f740 validates pushing zClass_Class::gwNodeFindNextByName_Predicate and tailing into zClass_List::IterateBucketFiltered with the incoming node name and bucket arguments.
The native smoke verifies seed-call/null-call exact-name iteration returns the matching node in bucket order and then returns null at end of iteration.
